title: A passing native declared run stays unknown/noPid: its results.json has exitCode null, which the run index never treats as terminal
outcome: A native declared run whose verification settled as passed is listed, carded and waited on as passed, even when the provider reported success without a numeric exit code.
acceptance: A behavioral regression writes the native registration results the host produces for a Claude foreground declared success (state passed, ended set, exitCode null) and shows GET /api/test-runs and the run's wait settle it as passed, not unknown/noPid; a failing native run (exit 1) still settles as failed.
No launcher-run behaviour changes: a launcher results.json without an integer exitCode is still not terminal.
